report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but all current gateway evidence is healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms, OK trace, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. No deployment or memory-retention facts exist. Current telemetry contradicts the alert and does not establish any bounded root cause, so hand off for downstream evidence rather than assert a candidate.
missing_evidence: Current gateway telemetry shows healthy signals (error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms, OK traces); need evidence of the actual error/latency spike to confirm the alert
Per-service error-rate and latency breakdown for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql to localize the fault
Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiter metrics for downstream services (order, payment, postgresql)
Logs from downstream services showing errors or timeouts during the alert window
